tasks.description: Implement the catalogue-defined typed report-query boundary, `SignalReportSourcePort` contract, and interactor behavior in `libs/usecase/src/signal_report/`, with independently verifiable mock-based port and interactor tests. GO-01, IN-01–IN-04, CN-01–CN-02, AC-01–AC-04.
After T001, implement and independently verify the catalogue-defined `SystemSignalReportSourceAdapter` in `libs/infrastructure/src/signal_report/`. IN-04, CN-01, AC-01, AC-04.
After T001, implement filter-to-query conversion in `apps/cli-driver/src/signal_report/`. IN-03, AC-03.
After T001 and T003, implement the `SignalReportDriver` occurrence-rendering contribution in `apps/cli-driver/src/signal_report/`. IN-02, CN-02, AC-01, AC-02.

After T001, T002, and T004, preserve and confirm the existing `SignalDriver` reference edge while adding and independently verifying `SignalCompositionRoot::signal_report_driver` wiring in `apps/cli-composition/`, before CLI report dispatch consumes it. CN-01, AC-01, AC-04.

After T003, T004, and T006, add the parsing and command shape that makes `sotp signal report` parseable in `apps/cli/src/commands/signal/mod.rs`: `SignalReportChainArg`, `SignalReportOnlyArg`, `SignalReportArgs`, and `SignalCommand::Report`; add same-module parsing tests. IN-01, IN-03, AC-03.

After T005, T004, and T006, add the signal-report branch of `execute` in `apps/cli/src/commands/signal/mod.rs`, constructing and using the composition-root report driver while propagating output and exit status; add focused dispatch tests. IN-01, AC-01.
After T008, add `sotp track resolve` regression tests in `apps/cli/src/commands/track/resolve.rs`. OUT-01, AC-05.

description: Add signal-report CLI parsing, then dispatch through the composition-root report driver, and finally add `apps/cli/src/commands/track/resolve.rs` regression validation. IN-01, IN-03, OUT-01, CN-01, AC-01, AC-03–AC-05.
